items.summary: Remove the Viewer Timer feature entirely from the Watch page UI so no timer controls, timer sidebar, or timer-related text are shown on mobile or desktop.

Implement backend comment storage and APIs so comments can be created and fetched per media item (keyed by the Watch page media title). Include comment text, author principal, and createdAt timestamp in the stored record, and return comments in reverse-chronological order (newest first).
Add React Query hooks to fetch and post comments via the backend actor, and ensure caches update immediately after posting (invalidate/refetch the relevant comments query for that media title).

Add a comments section under the media on the Watch page that (a) lists existing comments and (b) allows signed-in users to post a new comment. Guests can read comments but must sign in to post (show an English sign-in prompt and disable/hide the submit action for guests).
